prompt:
Use the provided crop as the approved visual reference and recreate it as a clean production asset at the target aspect ratio. This is a designed illustration plate. Output the same drawing, same style, same line weight and shading. Preserve silhouette, composition, perspective, palette (#f3f7f8, #0850f3, #8ed0f8), lighting, material, and texture exactly. Remove every piece of UI text, label, caption, button, and interface chrome that is not part of the artwork itself. Remove letterboxing, borders, card corners, drop shadows, and any layout background that the page will draw in code. Do not add objects. Do not change the concept. Do not restyle. The artwork fills the whole frame edge to edge at the same scale as the reference; no margins, no border, no background band. Region: sweeping ribbon of saturated blue light, deep blue through azure with sky highlights, folding from the top right and fading into white haze on its left.

Harness: openai-codex gpt-image-2-codex via omp generate_image, reference .impeccable/build/crops/ribbon.png, 1024x1024 request returned 1254x1254, upscaled to 1500x1500 with ffmpeg lanczos. Additional instruction: frosted demo window, button, navigation words, headline fragments and bottom icons removed; ribbon and white haze continued; ground outside the light pure white.

Revision 2026-10-11 per owner feedback 'Päris hea, sinist seal taustal võiks natuke vähem olla': the generated plate was lightened toward white in numpy (keep factor 0.82, extra fade on the left from 35% to 100% across 10-75% of the width, bottom fade to 45% across 55-95% of the height); share of clearly tinted pixels 62% -> 49%. Shape and palette otherwise unchanged.
